item.guid: 5 games now available on Nintendo Classics
item.title: 5 games now available on Nintendo Classics
item.description: Fortified Zone (Game Boy), The Sword of Hope II (Game Boy), Wario Land: Super Mario Land 3 (Game Boy), Dr. Mario & Puzzle League (Game Boy Advance), and Tomato Adventure (Game Boy Advance) are now available on Nintendo Classics
